title: Tactical DDD: Agents Context Sync Generator

adrDirectory.description: Where the library's architecture decision records are copied to. The folder is owned by this generator: files it no longer ships are removed.
adrDirectory.x-prompt: Which directory should the library's decision records be synced into?

guide.description: Path to an existing architecture guide to point at instead of the default. Without it, CLAUDE.md is used when it is the only guide present, and AGENTS.md is generated when the workspace has none.
guide.x-prompt: Which existing file holds the architecture guide for agents?

prefix.description: Organization prefix used in the generated guide's package-name examples, e.g. '@my-org'. Only applies when the guide is created; an existing one is never rewritten.
prefix.x-prompt: Which organization prefix should the guide's examples use (e.g. @my-org)?

check.description: Report drift instead of fixing it: fails when a record is missing, stale, or was generated by another plugin version. Intended for CI.
